description: לחיצת יד ואימות ישות משפטית וייפוי כוח מוגבל תקציב מול מנוע המסחר (POST /tagli/v1/agent/handshake). Agent credentials and delegation proof must be passed strictly via HTTP transport headers (Authorization: Bearer, X-Tagli-Agent-Key, X-Tagli-Delegation-Token, Mcp-Session-Id), never in tool arguments.

mandate.description: Non-secret mandate parameters (such as max_authorized_budget_ils). Never place secrets here.

max_authorized_budget_ils.description: Requested budget ceiling in ILS within the principal delegation mandate.

principal.description: Legal entity details including legal_name, registration_id (ח.פ/ע.מ), and authorized_officer (name/full_name, email, phone).

name: agentic_handshake
title: Agent Delegation Handshake
